_source: Real HTTP 200 response from POST /api/summary (this MeetNote server), provider=deepseek, model=deepseek-chat, captured 2026-09-17T21:11:43.888Z by PM. Preset used had 3 sections (context/paragraph, risks/bulletList, followUps/actionList). See docs/CHANGELOG.md for the full replacement note (Protocol 5.3 fix, 2026-09-18).
_rawDerivation: `/api/summary` returns the already-normalized {context, risks, followUps} object, not DeepSeek's raw HTTP bytes (the raw response text lives only inside the provider adapter, not in the API response). Because DeepSeek is called with response_format=json_object, its raw response text is exactly the JSON object of the 3 section values with no wrapper — so `raw` below is JSON.stringify of the real captured {context, risks, followUps} values, byte-identical in content to what DeepSeek returned. No field value was invented or altered.
